source: Currently in Newton on their second night, the group's management have apparently sought asylum arrangements with the city-state. Henry Temba, Newton's Exterior Minister, has confirmed that protection is being sought, stating that "(the city) will not allow people to be forced to make a choice between free speech, and their safety. We welcome these young men to our community, and will continue to oppose the blatant hypocrisy still rife in the Concord."  [
target: 组合目前在牛顿市停留到第二晚，经纪团队似乎已向这个城市国家寻求庇护安排。牛顿市外交部长亨利·滕巴确认，有人正在申请保护，并表示：“本市不会让人被迫在言论自由与人身安全之间作出选择。我们欢迎这些年轻人加入我们的社区，也会继续反对康科德仍然猖獗的公然虚伪。”[
